package io.github.xyz1001.pdsync.android;

import static pdsync.i18n.AndroidHostMessages.*;
import static pdsync.i18n.PrepareMessages.*;

import java.io.IOException;

/** Lifecycle/scheduler/coordinator ports. The three Activity methods and result branch are production code. */
final class MainActivity {
    static final int RESULT_OK = -1, RESULT_CANCELED = 0;
    enum DiagnosticAction { INSTALL }
    static final class ModeChoice {
        Object request;
        Object pending() { return request; }
    }
    static final class SetupSession {
        boolean running, externalCheckPending;
        final ModeChoice modeChoice = new ModeChoice();
        MainActivity owner;
        Runnable scheduled;
    }
    static final class Installer {
        boolean active = true, observation, exact, verified, failCheckpoint, failVerification;
        boolean selectedReceipt = true, immutableShare = true;
        String nonce = "request-one";
        int requestCode = 16001;
        int returns, checks, selections, revokes;
        String requestNonce() { return nonce; }
        int externalActivityRequestCode() { return requestCode; }
        String state() { return active ? "EXTERNAL_INSTALL" : observation ? "EXTERNAL_RETURNED" : "READY"; }
        boolean externalInstallPending() { return active; }
        boolean externalInstallObservation() { return observation; }
        void externalActivityReturned(String expected) throws IOException {
            if (!active || !nonce.equals(expected)) return;
            if (failCheckpoint) throw new IOException("Checkpoint unavailable");
            returns++; active = false; observation = true;
        }
        void checkExternalInstall() throws IOException {
            checks++;
            if (failVerification) throw new IOException("Package changed during verification");
            if (!exact) return;
            active = observation = false; verified = true; selectedReceipt = false;
            immutableShare = false; selections++; revokes++;
        }
        String summary() { return verified ? "Verified installed package" : "Not yet verified"; }
        void supersede() { active = observation = false; nonce = "new-selection"; }
    }
    interface Task<T> { T run() throws Exception; }
    interface Done<T> { void accept(MainActivity owner, T value) throws Exception; }

    final Installer installer;
    final SetupSession setupSession;
    boolean resumed = true, busy, destroyed, deferWork;
    String notice, setupOutcome;
    int errors, readiness, workStarts;
    MainActivity() { this(new Installer(), new SetupSession()); }
    MainActivity(Installer installer, SetupSession session) {
        this.installer = installer; this.setupSession = session; session.owner = this;
    }
    boolean isDestroyed() { return destroyed; }
    void reportError(Exception error) { errors++; }
    void refreshReadiness() { readiness++; }

    <T> void setupWork(DiagnosticAction action, String message, Task<T> task, Done<T> done) {
        if (busy || setupSession.running || destroyed) return;
        busy = setupSession.running = true; workStarts++;
        Runnable work = () -> {
            MainActivity owner = setupSession.owner;
            try {
                T result = task.run();
                busy = false; owner.busy = false; setupSession.running = false;
                done.accept(owner, result);
            } catch (Exception failure) {
                busy = false; owner.busy = false; setupSession.running = false;
                owner.reportError(failure);
            }
            /* PRODUCTION_COMPLETION_DRAIN */
        };
        if (deferWork) { deferWork = false; setupSession.scheduled = work; }
        else work.run();
    }
    void finishDeferredWork() {
        Runnable work = setupSession.scheduled; setupSession.scheduled = null;
        require(work != null, "Deferred verification work exists"); work.run();
    }
    void completeOtherSetupWork() {
        busy = setupSession.running = false;
        MainActivity owner = this;
        /* PRODUCTION_COMPLETION_DRAIN */
    }
    void resumeExternalObservation() {
        resumed = true;
        /* PRODUCTION_RESUME_QUEUE */
        drainExternalInstallation();
    }
    void externalInstallResult(int resultCode) {
        externalInstallResult(installer.externalActivityRequestCode(), resultCode);
    }

    /* PRODUCTION_METHODS */

    static int scenarios;
    static void require(boolean condition, String reason) { if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(reason); }
    static void retainsUnverifiedShare(MainActivity a) {
        require(!a.installer.active && a.installer.observation, "True result releases only the business wait");
        require(!a.installer.verified && a.installer.selections == 0 && a.installer.selectedReceipt,
                "Unverified return neither reports success nor consumes selected-file intent");
        require(a.installer.immutableShare && a.installer.revokes == 0,
                "Unverified return preserves the immutable share for background installation");
    }
    static void resultCodesNeverProveSuccess() {
        for (int code : new int[] {RESULT_OK, RESULT_CANCELED, 1, 37}) {
            MainActivity a = new MainActivity();
            a.externalInstallResult(code);
            retainsUnverifiedShare(a);
            require(a.installer.returns == 1 && a.installer.checks == 1 && a.readiness == 1,
                    "Every external result code records the boundary and checks actual package state");
            a.drainExternalInstallation(); a.drainExternalInstallation();
            require(a.installer.checks == 1 && a.workStarts == 1, "Duplicate drains do not replay verification");
        }
        scenarios++;
    }
    static void ordinaryResumeDoesNotInventReturn() {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity();
        a.resumed = false; a.resumeExternalObservation(); a.resumeExternalObservation();
        require(a.installer.active && !a.installer.observation && a.installer.returns == 0,
                "Plain resume cannot invent an external Activity return");
        require(a.installer.checks == 0 && a.workStarts == 0 && a.installer.immutableShare,
                "Plain resume does not poll or revoke an outstanding external share");
        scenarios++;
    }
    static void pausedReturnWaitsForResume() {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity(); a.resumed = false;
        a.externalInstallResult(RESULT_CANCELED); retainsUnverifiedShare(a);
        require(a.setupSession.externalCheckPending && a.installer.checks == 0,
                "Paused callback retains its pending check instead of losing the return");
        a.resumeExternalObservation();
        require(a.installer.checks == 1 && !a.setupSession.externalCheckPending,
                "Resume drains a queued return once"); scenarios++;
    }
    static void busyReturnWaitsForCompletion() {
        for (boolean running : new boolean[] {false, true}) {
            MainActivity a = new MainActivity(); a.busy = !running; a.setupSession.running = running;
            a.externalInstallResult(RESULT_CANCELED); retainsUnverifiedShare(a);
            require(a.installer.checks == 0 && a.setupSession.externalCheckPending,
                    "Busy or running setup retains the return before verification can start");
            a.completeOtherSetupWork();
            require(a.installer.checks == 1 && !a.setupSession.externalCheckPending,
                    "Setup completion drains the queued external return");
        }
        scenarios++;
    }
    static void foregroundChoiceDefersObservation() {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity(); a.setupSession.modeChoice.request = new Object();
        a.externalInstallResult(RESULT_CANCELED);
        require(a.setupSession.externalCheckPending && a.installer.checks == 0,
                "An open source choice defers observation without losing it");
        a.setupSession.modeChoice.request = null; a.drainExternalInstallation();
        require(a.installer.checks == 1, "Closing the choice allows the preserved return to drain"); scenarios++;
    }
    static void deferredWorkCannotDuplicate() {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity(); a.deferWork = true;
        a.externalInstallResult(RESULT_OK); a.drainExternalInstallation(); a.drainExternalInstallation();
        require(a.workStarts == 1 && a.installer.checks == 0 && a.setupSession.running,
                "An asynchronous return check is scheduled only once");
        a.finishDeferredWork(); retainsUnverifiedShare(a);
        require(a.installer.checks == 1 && !a.busy && !a.setupSession.running,
                "Deferred check completes and leaves the business flow unlocked"); scenarios++;
    }
    static void rotationKeepsQueuedReturn() {
        MainActivity old = new MainActivity(); old.resumed = false;
        old.externalInstallResult(RESULT_CANCELED); old.destroyed = true;
        MainActivity current = new MainActivity(old.installer, old.setupSession);
        current.resumeExternalObservation();
        require(current.installer.checks == 1 && current.readiness == 1 && old.readiness == 0,
                "Rotation drains the retained return through the current Activity"); scenarios++;
    }
    static void rotationDuringCheckUsesCurrentOwner() {
        MainActivity old = new MainActivity(); old.deferWork = true; old.externalInstallResult(RESULT_CANCELED);
        old.destroyed = true; old.resumed = false;
        MainActivity current = new MainActivity(old.installer, old.setupSession);
        current.finishDeferredWork();
        require(current.readiness == 1 && old.readiness == 0 && !current.setupSession.running,
                "An in-flight external check completes against the retained current owner"); scenarios++;
    }
    static void restartAndLateExactProof() {
        MainActivity old = new MainActivity(); old.resumed = false; old.externalInstallResult(RESULT_CANCELED);
        MainActivity current = new MainActivity(old.installer, new SetupSession());
        current.resumeExternalObservation(); retainsUnverifiedShare(current);
        current.installer.exact = true; current.resumeExternalObservation();
        require(current.installer.verified && current.installer.selections == 1 && current.installer.revokes == 1,
                "A durable returned checkpoint accepts late verified package proof exactly once");
        current.resumeExternalObservation(); current.drainExternalInstallation();
        require(current.installer.checks == 2 && current.installer.selections == 1,
                "Completed proof stops further automatic external checks"); scenarios++;
    }
    static void staleObservationCannotChangeNewSelection() {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity(); a.resumed = false; a.externalInstallResult(RESULT_CANCELED);
        a.installer.supersede(); a.installer.exact = true;
        a.resumeExternalObservation(); a.drainExternalInstallation();
        require(a.installer.checks == 0 && a.installer.selections == 0 && a.installer.revokes == 0,
                "Stale queued observation cannot verify or bind after a new selection supersedes it");
        require(!a.setupSession.externalCheckPending, "A stale queued observation is discarded once"); scenarios++;
    }
    static void persistenceAndVerificationFailuresStaySafe() {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity(); a.installer.failCheckpoint = true;
        a.externalInstallResult(RESULT_CANCELED);
        require(a.errors == 1 && a.installer.active && a.installer.checks == 0,
                "Failed return persistence cannot authorize verification or pretend the checkpoint changed");
        a = new MainActivity(); a.installer.failVerification = true; a.externalInstallResult(RESULT_OK);
        retainsUnverifiedShare(a);
        require(a.errors == 1 && !a.busy, "Failed verification does not restore the business lock");
        a.installer.failVerification = false; a.installer.exact = true; a.resumeExternalObservation();
        require(a.installer.verified && a.installer.selections == 1,
                "A later real observation can recover from a transient verification error"); scenarios++;
    }
    static void oldCallbackCannotUnlockNewRequest() {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity();
        int oldRequestCode = a.installer.externalActivityRequestCode();
        a.externalInstallResult(RESULT_CANCELED);
        a.installer.active = true; a.installer.observation = false;
        a.installer.nonce = "request-two"; a.installer.requestCode++;
        a.externalInstallResult(oldRequestCode, RESULT_CANCELED);
        a.externalInstallResult(8107, RESULT_OK);
        require(a.installer.active && !a.installer.observation && a.installer.returns == 1
                        && a.installer.checks == 1 && !a.setupSession.externalCheckPending,
                "A stale old callback cannot release a newer external request");
        a.externalInstallResult(RESULT_CANCELED);
        require(!a.installer.active && a.installer.observation && a.installer.returns == 2,
                "The newer request unlocks only on its own Activity result"); scenarios++;
    }
    static void legacyRequestCodeStillReturns() {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity(); a.installer.requestCode = 8107;
        a.externalInstallResult(8107, RESULT_CANCELED); retainsUnverifiedShare(a);
        require(a.installer.returns == 1 && a.installer.checks == 1,
                "A matching legacy outstanding request can finish through the original request code"); scenarios++;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        resultCodesNeverProveSuccess(); ordinaryResumeDoesNotInventReturn(); pausedReturnWaitsForResume();
        busyReturnWaitsForCompletion(); foregroundChoiceDefersObservation(); deferredWorkCannotDuplicate();
        rotationKeepsQueuedReturn(); rotationDuringCheckUsesCurrentOwner(); restartAndLateExactProof();
        staleObservationCannotChangeNewSelection(); persistenceAndVerificationFailuresStaySafe();
        oldCallbackCannotUnlockNewRequest(); legacyRequestCodeStillReturns();
        System.out.println("external return execution passed: " + scenarios + " scenarios");
        System.out.println("Boundary: production Activity return/drain/check methods and external result branch; lifecycle, scheduling, coordinator, and PackageManager are ports. No Android device installation evidence.");
    }
}
